verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a hosted autonomous research service. Exposing an official MCP server so other agents can start research runs is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server, API, or programmatic agent integration, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
